invariants.rationale: Since the method returns a new instance of HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable or HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable, result is never null.
Method parameter config is used to construct result and expected to be non-null.
Method parameter context is used to construct result and expected to be non-null.
Method parameter metaClient is used to determine table type and construct result and expected to be non-null.
Result is an instance of either HoodieJavaCopyOnWriteTable or HoodieJavaMergeOnReadTable which both extend HoodieJavaTable.
